csm-wb.name: WB 10-A and WB 14-A CNC wire bending machines, Ø5/32″ to Ø9/16″ wire from coil
csm-wb.summary: A 3D CNC wire bender fed from the coil: the decoiler, hydraulic straightener and servo feeder bring the wire to a servo bending head that bends at up to 1,000°/s with ±0.01° repeatability, rotates the work-head 440°/s for the next plane and shifts between concentric tools, then a hydraulic cutter drops the finished part — baskets, racks, handles, hooks, springs, brackets and display frames in Ø5/32″ to Ø3/8″ (WB 10-A) or Ø1/4″ to Ø9/16″ (WB 14-A) wire. The customised work-head avoids interference on complex shapes; the IPC control with a 15″ touch-screen simulates the part in 3D before the first wire is bent.
csm-wb.headline: 3D CNC from the coil · Ø5/32″ – Ø9/16″ · 1,000°/s · ±0.01°
features: Work-head rotation by servo motor, 440°/s, ±0.01°; tooling shift by servo motor, concentric tool design
Feeding by servo motor at 164 ft/min, ±0.004″; straightening by hydraulics; uncoiling by AC motor
Cutting by hydraulics; customised work-head eliminates interference
IPC control with 15″ touch-screen and 3D simulation
CSA-approved electrical panel; 600 V 3-phase with transformer (208 / 240 / 480 V on request)
optional: Tooling to your wire and radii
Custom voltage: 208 V, 240 V, 480 V or 600 V 3-phase
